tara: Heads-up  I'm updating Hello quickstart to prefer OIDC for private/Dedicated. Plan: add Node + Go SDK examples for the new flow, include a tiny local auth-proxy compose for dev, and a short migration checklist. Need copycheck and a CI smoke job.

josh: Sounds good. Can you drop the exact snippets you'll add so I can validate the copy/paste? Also confirm we keep a legacy API_KEY example somewhere.
	mina: We should include a one-liner for local dev to avoid friction. Also QA needs a reproducible smoke test.

tara: Snippets (will be in code blocks):

Node (.env):
REDWOOD_AUTH_MODE=oidc
REDWOOD_OIDC_ISSUER=https://idp.example.com
OIDC_CLIENT_ID=hello-qs-node
REDWOOD_LOCAL_AUTH_PROXY=true

Node example:
const {Client} = require('redwood')
const c = new Client({authMode: 'oidc'})
await c.generate('hello').then(r => console.log(r.text))

Go example (pseudo):
import redwood "github.com/redwood/rr"
cli := redwood.NewClient(redwood.Config{AuthMode: "oidc"})
resp, _ := cli.Generate("hello")
fmt.Println(resp.Text)

Legacy API key: will remain in a collapsible appendix for 7 days.

josh: LGTM on snippets. Minor nit: call the local service "local auth proxy (dev-only)" and add a bold security callout: do not use in production.
	mina: For CI, I'll add `ci/docs_quickstart_oidc_smoke.sh` that: 1) brings up compose with the proxy, 2) uses prow secret helper to inject a test client secret, 3) runs `tests/quickstart_oidc_smoke.py`, 4) tears down. I'll also add a small healthcheck that hits `/token-exchange` and asserts 200.

qa-bot: Please add `---ci:quickstart-oidc-smoke` label to the PR so the docs pipeline picks it up. Make sure tests do not leak secrets into logs.

tara: Will add the PR description with local run one-liner: `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker.compose.dev.yml up --build && ./scripts/dev/seed_oidc_test_secrets.sh && ./scripts/dev/run_quickstart_smoke.sh`. Also adding migration checklist: 1) create OIDC client in IdP, 2) add redirect URIs, 3) move secret to KMS/HSM, 4) update REDWOOD_AUTH_MODE, 5) run smoke tests and monitor token rotation.

josh: Good. I'll review the PR once it's up. Quick doc nit: link Private Deploy auth page `/private-deploy/auth` from the migration checklist.

	mina: I'll wire the CI job after PR lands. If QA smoke passes we'll merge after docs + eng signoff.
	josh: :thumbsup:
